rationale: PBR.A has gapped down ~17.55% with no news context available to explain the move, making directional conviction extremely low — the gap could be dividend-related, a political/regulatory event, or a data artifact, and without knowing the cause the risk of fading or following is unquantifiable. With an existing working long in NU and no clear mechanical edge here, skipping preserves capital.
